about: A month or a run of weeks as a calendar grid, with days ringed or runs of days filled as they are said, and a key of what each mark means: schedules, deadlines, how often something happens, cycles over days, a plan for a month.

start.about: which column the first day falls in, 0 to 6

weekdays.about: seven column headings, split by |; else M T W T F S S

marks.about: days or runs of days and what they are, as 12:name or 3-7:name, split by |

style.about: ring or fill for every mark; else runs are filled and single days ringed

when.about: moments each mark is drawn; else when its name is said, or one after another
